definitions.meaning: to be passed along from one place to another, circulating

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means both lasting a full boxing contest and circulating from person to person or place to place.

clue.text: Modulation on a few lines makes for a Straussian speciality

parts.note: modulation of the voice is its tone
a short piece of verse is a poem

explanation.surface: A key change in a short verse is the sort of thing Richard Strauss excelled at.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'on' puts the first piece above the second.
explanation.definitionFit: Richard Strauss wrote many orchestral works of this programmatic kind, such as Don Juan.

clue.text: Time to muse?

parts.note: an era is a period of time

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether it is time to sit and think.
explanation.walkthrough: 'muse' looks like a verb meaning ponder; it is a noun, one of the nine Muses of Greek myth.
explanation.definitionFit: She is the Muse of lyric and love poetry in Greek mythology.

clue.text: Pompous circles retain a tenor

parts.note: the letter O is shaped like a circle

indicators.note: to retain is to hold something within, so one piece sits inside another

parts.note: a circle can also be called a round

explanation.surface: Self-important social groups keep a singer of the higher male voice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'circles' gives two pieces, O and ROUND, and 'retain' puts T inside ROUND.
explanation.definitionFit: An orotund voice or style is pompous and inflated, full and grand in delivery.

clue.text: Used DOS to come out of video nasty ordered in innocence

indicators.note: the remaining letters are put in a new order
letters coming out of a phrase are removed from it

parts.note: taken as the three letters D, O and S

explanation.surface: A computer operating system is used to remove something from a horror film in the name of innocence.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing D, O and S from VIDEONASTY leaves VIEANTY, which 'ordered' rearranges. A video nasty is a British term for a violent horror film on video.
explanation.definitionFit: Naivety is guileless simplicity, the lack of worldly experience that innocence implies.

clue.text: Star plant producing high quality oil

definitions.text: Star plant producing high quality oil

parts.words: Star plant producing high quality oil
parts.note: the plant is named after a star, the one our planet circles, and its seeds are pressed for a fine cooking oil

explanation.definitionFit: This tall yellow bloom follows the sun and its seeds yield a widely used cooking oil.

clue.text: Go downhill by means of wind power when first cut out

indicators.note: the first letter is cut out of the word

parts.note: to travel by wind power is to sail

explanation.surface: Someone skis or glides downhill under wind power until the first part is cut short.
explanation.definitionFit: To ail is to be unwell, to decline in health, which is going downhill.

clue.text: Deity the French raised is put on a soluble base

indicators.note: in a down clue, raised means read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: la is the feminine form of the in French
Kali is a Hindu goddess

explanation.surface: A god and a French article are placed on top of something soluble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is put on' sets the reversed AL above KALI in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: In chemistry, a base that dissolves in water is called by this name.

clue.text: Foolhardiness of asylum seekers?

parts.note: asylum here is the old lunatic asylum, so those seeking one would be mad

explanation.definitionFit: Lunacy is madness, and figuratively reckless folly or foolhardiness.

clue.text: They order en bloc something from a Cajun takeaway

explanation.definitionFit: A junta is a military group that rules a country collectively after a coup.

explanation.definitionFit: This is a thin, glossy, translucent paper, named after the papery outer layer of a bulb.

clue.text: Propagate in the matter of fruit and vegetables

farm goods such as fruit and vegetables are called produce

clue.text: Start part of play with a revolutionary Evita

explanation.walkthrough: 'revolutionary' seems to describe the musical's heroine; it signals the anagram of EVITA. 'with a' just joins.
explanation.definitionFit: To activate something is to set it going, to start it.

clue.text: One hard to crack lets go initially, as daughter enters with cake

explanation.definitionFit: A doughnut is a small ring or ball of fried sweet dough, a kind of small cake.

clue.text: Record empire being scoured by the sword
